subject: From Ziggy: Grok cannot yet render James's ink as legible writing; one more Grok round, then AI Studio or Flow for the lettering pass if it misses; the James look is not locked; a stencil-and-composite try suggested
body:
Ziggy, in the session by voice at about 06:00 UTC, in substance: Grok is not able to get the James image right, the designed tattoos rendered as legible writing per ink rev 3 (95c42de4…); he has told Grok to go one more round and will look at that return himself; if it still misses, he wants another route tried for the lettering pass, Google AI Studio (Gemini) or Flow, your lanes; we cannot lock the designed tattoos until some route renders the writing legibly, so the James look is not locked and nobody should expect the ink to come out as drawn. The same note went to your dot at 06:01 UTC. Recorded as DECISIONS item 60; open item 23 (the lock) now also waits on a route that can render lettering.

Writer's suggestion for the test, not a request and not a lane change: lettering is the one thing every image model has done badly for the project (the GAIIB chin that took three repair patches; the mouth shapes), so a stencil-and-composite route, Grok's black-on-white stencil sheets (stencil_set_v003 already on D:) laid onto the v004 clean reference in Comfy, may beat a one-shot regeneration and is worth one bounded try beside a Gemini edit if Ziggy wants it. The adopted original (957897bd…) stays James's reference whatever renders. No run requested by me; Grok's extra round is Ziggy's own instruction to Grok, not a dispatch of yours.
source: Ziggy in Claude's session by voice, 2026-10-14 about 06:00 UTC.
